explication: System-tests is a black-box, cross-language workbench for checking Datadog tracer behavior. A test selects a scenario, exercises a tracer through its test application, and validates captured traces and other signals at component interfaces. The graph also preserves documented parametric, OpenTelemetry, AppSec, SSI/Kubernetes-injection, and onboarding capabilities. Source excerpts and the index show some shared runtime connections; links based only on README descriptions are labeled as documented. Unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
